test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A motorboat, whose speed in 15 km/h in still water goes 50 km downstream and comes back in a total of 7 hours 30 minutes. The speed of the stream (in km/h) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distance upstream and downstream, Total Time = [Distance × (2 × Speed of Boat)] ÷ (Speed of Boat² − Stream Speed²)

⇒ 7.5 = [50 × (2 × 15)] ÷ (15² − s²)

⇒ 7.5 = 1500 ÷ (225 − s²)

⇒ 225 − s² = 200 ⇒ s² = 25

⇒ s = 5 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the motorboat in still water (v) = 15 km/h

Distance covered in each direction (D) = 50 km

Total time taken (T) = 7 hours 30 minutes = 7.5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream Speed = v + s

Upstream Speed = v − s

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90d7d394c756d0fc671f442f987c0cb89eb4edd7960a13bb347a629a5b6a8a95.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the stream be s km/h.

⇒ Time taken downstream = 50 ÷ (15 + s)

⇒ Time taken upstream = 50 ÷ (15 − s)

Since the total time is 7.5 hours:

⇒ [50 ÷ (15 + s)] + [50 ÷ (15 − s)] = 7.5

Taking 50 common from the numerator:

⇒ 50 × [1 ÷ (15 + s) + 1 ÷ (15 − s)] = 7.5

⇒ 50 × [(15 − s + 15 + s) ÷ (15 + s)(15 − s)] = 7.5

⇒ 50 × [30 ÷ (225 − s²)] = 7.5

⇒ 1500 ÷ (225 − s²) = 7.5

⇒ 225 − s² = 1500 ÷ 7.5

⇒ 225 − s² = 200

⇒ s² = 225 − 200

⇒ s² = 25

⇒ s = 5 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If the downstream speed is D and upstream speed is U, then the speed of the boat in still water = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

If the downstream speed is D and upstream speed is U, then the speed of the stream = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

When going downstream and returning upstream over the same distance, Average speed = (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).
